title: string — specific, outcome-oriented headline (e.g. 'How I Reduced Churn 18% Using Behavioral Cohort Segmentation')
subtitle: string — specific, outcome-oriented subtitle for this article. It should align with the headline or the takeaway.
seoTitle: string — rewritten for search intent; include 1–2 primary keywords naturally. Best Practice: Keep under 50-60 characters, place the primary keyword at the beginning, and include the brand name.
seoDescription: string — The snippet of text below the title tag in SERPs that summarizes the page's content. Best Practice: Aim for 150-160 characters. It should be compelling to encourage clicks (acting as a sales pitch) and include keywords, which are often bolded by search engines.
seoKeywords: array of strings — 8–10 tags ordered most to least relevant; lowercase; hyphens for multi-word terms; real practitioner vocabulary only (for SEO)
category: string — exactly one value from the Active Categories list in categories.md; must match character-for-character
tags: array of strings — 8–10 tags ordered most to least relevant; lowercase; hyphens for multi-word terms; real practitioner vocabulary only
timeToRead: integer — body word count ÷ 200, rounded to nearest minute
mainImagePromptToGenerateImageUsingAI: string — detailed AI image generation prompt including subject matter, mood, colour palette, composition, and visual style as the final sentence
mainImageCaption: string — A short 1-line phrase or sentence to be used as a caption for the main image of this article and aligns with the content of this article.
